# Pitch Expression

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PitchExpression`](gmeow-PitchExpression.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchExpression>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A common superclass for pitch-related quantities that are expressed relative to a [`TuningSystem`](gmeow-TuningSystem.md). [`PitchValue`](gmeow-PitchValue.md) and [`PitchInterval`](gmeow-PitchInterval.md) are its subkinds; using a named class avoids anonymous union classes as property domains in generated schemas ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PitchExpression`](gmeow-PitchExpression.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
